routes.static-scan: a deterministic scan of source text/AST decides the clause (e.g. no clock read, a pinned list equals a documented list)
routes.call-graph: a deterministic call/import graph rule decides the clause (A reaches/does not reach B; all of X call helper H; call order inside one body)
routes.law: the clause states an input/output, equivalence or ordering property of code that a property test or proof could decide
routes.artefact-check: deterministic, but decided only against build/CI artefacts or GitHub state, not against the source tree
routes.judgment: intent, quality or impact statement with no decidable oracle
routes.rationale: a 'why' sentence; not a normative claim, excluded from the translatable denominator

_rubric.entry_rule: full = every normative clause has a non-judgment route; partial = some do; none = no normative clause does. proxy = the deterministic route checks a textual proxy (phrase presence) rather than the semantic claim.
